newsitem.title: USA: US LPG market a tad weaker in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: US LPG market a tad weaker in quiet trade.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were a tad weaker in quiet trade on Wednesday although propane found some support in recovering crude oil futures, player said.
Traders said there was a dearth of news in the market apart from stronger European pricing to on par with the U.S. Gulf Coast, which means little chance for imports to the region.
In Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane stayed steady at between 35.25 cents and 35.50 cents while Conway, Kansas, material shed a quarter cent to 37.25/37.50 cents.
The butane market was also a quarter cent lower, with Belvieu trading 40.75/41.00 cents and Conway at 38.25/38.50 cents. -- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
